heading.en: Jesus commands that the Church be called in His name—His mission and atoning sacrifice constitute His gospel—Men are commanded to repent and be baptized that they may be sanctified by the Holy Ghost—They are to be even as Jesus is. About A.D. 34–35.
heading.sm: Ua poloaiina i latou e Iesu ia faaigoa le ekalesia i Lona igoa—O lana misiona ma lana taulaga togiola o Lana talalelei lea—Ua poloaiina tagata ia salamo ma papatisoina ina ia mafai ona faapaiaina i latou e le Agaga Paia—Ia avea i latou ia pei lava o Iesu ia. E tusa o le 34–35 T.A.

verses.en: And it came to pass that as the disciples of Jesus were journeying and were preaching the things which they had both heard and seen, and were baptizing in the name of Jesus, it came to pass that the disciples were gathered together and were united in mighty prayer and fasting.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina malaga atu soo o Iesu ma a’o latou tala’i atu mea ia na latou faalogo ma vaaia, ma a o latou papatiso atu i le suafa o Iesu, sa oo ina faapotopoto faatasi le au soo ma aufaatasi i le tatalo faatauanau atu ma le anapogi.

verses.en: And Jesus again showed himself unto them, for they were praying unto the Father in his name; and Jesus came and stood in the midst of them, and said unto them: What will ye that I shall give unto you?
verses.sm: Ma sa toe faaali mai e Iesu o ia lava ia te i latou, ona sa latou tatalo atu i le Tamā i lona suafa; ma sa afio mai Iesu ma tulai i totonu o i latou, ma fetalai mai ia te i latou: O le a se mea ua outou mananao ou te tuu atu ia te outou?

verses.en: And they said unto him: Lord, we will that thou wouldst tell us the name whereby we shall call this church; for there are disputations among the people concerning this matter.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou fai mai ia te ia: Le Alii e, matou te mananao sei e ta’u mai ia te i matou le igoa matou te faaigoa ai lenei ekalesia; ona o loo i ai ni finauga i totonu o le nuu e faatatau i lenei mataupu.

verses.en: And the Lord said unto them: Verily, verily, I say unto you, why is it that the people should murmur and dispute because of this thing?
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai atu le Alii ia te i latou: E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, aisea ea ua tomumumu ma finau ai le nuu ona o lenei mea?

w.en: said the Lord of the vineyard

verses.en: Have they not read the scriptures, which say ye must take upon you the name of Christ, which is my name? For by this name shall ye be called at the last day;
verses.sm: Latou te lei faitau ea i tusitusiga paia, ia ua fai mai e ao ina outou ave i o outou luga le suafa o Keriso, o lo’u igoa lea? Ona o le igoa lea o le a valaau ai outou i le aso gataaga;

verses.en: And whoso taketh upon him my name, and endureth to the end, the same shall be saved at the last day.
verses.sm: Ma o soo se tasi na te ave i ona luga lo’u igoa, ma tumau seia oo i le iuga, o ia lava lea o le a faaolaina i le aso gataaga.

verses.en: Therefore, whatsoever ye shall do, ye shall do it in my name; therefore ye shall call the church in my name; and ye shall call upon the Father in my name that he will bless the church for my sake.
verses.sm: O lea, soo se mea tou te faia, ia outou faia i lo’u igoa; o lea ia outou faaigoa ai le ekalesia i lo’u igoa; ma ia outou valaau atu i le Tamā i lo’u igoa ia faamanuia mai o ia i le ekalesia ona o a’u.

verses.en: And how be it my church save it be called in my name? For if a church be called in Moses’ name then it be Moses’ church; or if it be called in the name of a man then it be the church of a man; but if it be called in my name then it is my church, if it so be that they are built upon my gospel.
verses.sm: Ma e faapefea ona avea ma a’u ekalesia vagana ai ua faaigoaina i lo’u igoa? Aua afai e faaigoaina se ekalesia i le igoa o Mose o lona uiga o le ekalesia lea a Mose; pe afai e faaigoaina i le igoa o se tagata o lona uiga o le ekalesia lea a le tagata; ae afai e faaigoaina i lo’u igoa o lona uiga o la’u ekalesia lea, pe afai ua atia’e i latou i luga o la’u talalelei.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, that ye are built upon my gospel; therefore ye shall call whatsoever things ye do call, in my name; therefore if ye call upon the Father, for the church, if it be in my name the Father will hear you;
verses.sm: E moni ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua atia’e outou i luga o la’u talalelei; o lea ia outou valaauina i lo’u igoa soo se mea tou te valaauina; o lea afai tou te valaau atu i le Tamā, mo le ekalesia, afai e faia i lo’u igoa o le a faafofoga mai le Tamā ia te outou.

verses.en: And if it so be that the church is built upon my gospel then will the Father show forth his own works in it.
verses.sm: Ma afai ua faapea ona atia’e o le ekalesia i luga o la’u talalelei ona faaali mai ai lea e le Tamā o ana lava galuega i totonu o ia mea.

verses.en: But if it be not built upon my gospel, and is built upon the works of men, or upon the works of the devil, verily I say unto you they have joy in their works for a season, and by and by the end cometh, and they are hewn down and cast into the fire, from whence there is no return.
verses.sm: Ae afai ua le atia’e i luga o la’u talalelei, ma ua atia’e i luga o galuega a tagata, po o luga o galuega a le tiapolo, e moni ou te fai atu ia te outou latou te maua le olioli i a latou galuega mo se vaitau, ma e toe itiiti ane oo mai le iuga, ma o le a taia i latou i lalo ma lafoaiina i le afi, lea ua leai se toe foi mai ai.

verses.en: For their works do follow them, for it is because of their works that they are hewn down; therefore remember the things that I have told you.
verses.sm: Aua e mulimuli atu a latou galuega ia te i latou, aua ona o a latou galuega ua taia ai i latou i lalo; o lea ia outou manatua ai mea ua ou ta’u atu ia te outou.

verses.en: Behold I have given unto you my gospel, and this is the gospel which I have given unto you—that I came into the world to do the will of my Father, because my Father sent me.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua ou tuu atu ia te outou la’u talalelei, ma o le talalelei lenei ua ou tuu atu ia te outou— e faapea, ua ou sau i le lalolagi e fai le finagalo o lo’u Tamā, aua na auina mai a’u e lo’u Tamā.

verses.en: And my Father sent me that I might be lifted up upon the cross; and after that I had been lifted up upon the cross, that I might draw all men unto me, that as I have been lifted up by men even so should men be lifted up by the Father, to stand before me, to be judged of their works, whether they be good or whether they be evil—
verses.sm: Ma na auina mai a’u e lo’u Tamā ina ia siitia a’e a’u i luga o le satauro; ma a mavae ona siitia a’e o a’u i luga o le satauro, ina ia mafai ona ou aumai o tagata uma ia te a’u, ina ia pei ona siitia a’e o a’u i luga e tagata ia faapea foi ona siitia a’e i luga o tagata e le Tamā, e tutulai i o’u luma, e faamasinoina i a latou galuega, pe ua lelei pe ua leaga—

w.en: that I might be lifted up

verses.en: And for this cause have I been lifted up; therefore, according to the power of the Father I will draw all men unto me, that they may be judged according to their works.
verses.sm: Ma le pogai lenei na siitia a’e ai a’u i luga; o lea, e tusa ai ma le mana o le Tamā, o le a ou aumai ai tagata uma ia te au, ina ia faamasinoina i latou e tusa ma a latou galuega.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that whoso repenteth and is baptized in my name shall be filled; and if he endureth to the end, behold, him will I hold guiltless before my Father at that day when I shall stand to judge the world.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai foi, o le a faatumuina soo se tasi e salamo ma papatiso i lo’u igoa; ma afai e tumau o ia seia oo i le iuga, faauta, o ia lea o le a ou le tausalaina i luma o lo’u Tamā i lena aso pe a ou tulai e faamasino i le lalolagi.

verses.en: And he that endureth not unto the end, the same is he that is also hewn down and cast into the fire, from whence they can no more return, because of the justice of the Father.
verses.sm: Ma o ia e le tumau seia oo i le iuga, o ia lava lea e tatuu foi i lalo ma lafo i le afi, o se mea e le mafai ona latou toe foi mai ai, ona o le faamasinotonu o le Tamā.

verses.en: And this is the word which he hath given unto the children of men. And for this cause he fulfilleth the words which he hath given, and he lieth not, but fulfilleth all his words.
verses.sm: Ma o le afioga lenei ua ia tuuina mai i le fanauga a tagata. Ma o le pogai lenei ua ia faataunuuina ai afioga ia na ia tuuina mai, ma e le pepelo lava ia, ae na te faataunuuina ana afioga uma.

verses.en: And no unclean thing can enter into his kingdom; therefore nothing entereth into his rest save it be those who have washed their garments in my blood, because of their faith, and the repentance of all their sins, and their faithfulness unto the end.
verses.sm: Ma e leai se mea le mama e mafai ona ulu atu i lona malo; o lea e leai se mea e ulu atu i lona malologa vagana ai i latou o e ua faamamaina o latou ofu i lo’u toto, ona o lo latou faatuatua, ma le salamo i a latou agasala uma, ma lo latou faamaoni e oo i le iuga.

verses.en: Now this is the commandment: Repent, all ye ends of the earth, and come unto me and be baptized in my name, that ye may be sanctified by the reception of the Holy Ghost, that ye may stand spotless before me at the last day.
verses.sm: O lenei o le poloaiga lenei: Ia salamo, outou tuluiga uma o le lalolagi, ma o mai ia te au ma ia papatiso i lo’u igoa, ina ia faapaiaina outou i le taliaina o le Agaga Paia, ina ia outou tutulai ma le le pona i o’u luma i le aso gataaga.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, this is my gospel; and ye know the things that ye must do in my church; for the works which ye have seen me do that shall ye also do; for that which ye have seen me do even that shall ye do;
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, o la’u talalelei lea; ma ua outou iloa mea e tatau ona outou faia i la’u ekalesia; ona o galuega na outou vaai na ou faia o mea ia tou te faia foi; aua o mea na outou vaai ua ou faia o mea lava ia ia outou faia;

verses.en: Therefore, if ye do these things blessed are ye, for ye shall be lifted up at the last day.
verses.sm: O lea, afai tou te faia nei mea, amuia outou, ona o le a siitia a’e outou i luga i le aso gataaga.

verses.en: Write the things which ye have seen and heard, save it be those which are forbidden.
verses.sm: Ia tusia mea na outou vaaia ma faalogoina, vagana ai mea ua faasaina.

verses.en: Write the works of this people, which shall be, even as hath been written, of that which hath been.
verses.sm: Ia tusia galuega a lenei nuu, ia o le a faia, e pei lava ona tusia, e uiga i mea ua mavae.

verses.en: For behold, out of the books which have been written, and which shall be written, shall this people be judged, for by them shall their works be known unto men.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, o tusi ua tusia, ma ia o le a tusia, o le a faamasinoina mai ai lenei nuu, ona o i latou o le a iloa ai e tagata a latou galuega.

verses.en: And behold, all things are written by the Father; therefore out of the books which shall be written shall the world be judged.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, ua tusia mea uma e le Tamā; o lea o mea mai tusi o le a tusia o le a faamasino ai le lalolagi.

verses.en: And know ye that ye shall be judges of this people, according to the judgment which I shall give unto you, which shall be just. Therefore, what manner of men ought ye to be? Verily I say unto you, even as I am.
verses.sm: Ma ia outou iloa o le a avea outou ma faamasino o lenei nuu, e tusa ma le faamasinoga o le a ou tuu atu ia te outou, lea o le a tonu. O lea, o a ituaiga o tagata e tatau ona outou i ai? E moni ou te fai atu ia te outou, e pei lava o A’u nei.

verses.en: And now I go unto the Father. And verily I say unto you, whatsoever things ye shall ask the Father in my name shall be given unto you.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ou te alu atu i le Tamā. Ma e moni ou te fai atu ia te outou, soo se mea tou te ole atu ai i le Tamā i lo’u igoa o le a tuuina mai ia te outou.

verses.en: Therefore, ask, and ye shall receive; knock, and it shall be opened unto you; for he that asketh, receiveth; and unto him that knocketh, it shall be opened.
verses.sm: O lea, ole atu, ma o le a outou maua; tu’itu’i atu, ma o le tatala mai ia te outou; aua o ia e ole atu, e maua e ia; ma o ia e tu’itu’i atu, o le a tatala mai i ai.

verses.en: And now, behold, my joy is great, even unto fulness, because of you, and also this generation; yea, and even the Father rejoiceth, and also all the holy angels, because of you and this generation; for none of them are lost.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, ua tele lo’u olioli, ua oo lava i le atoatoa, ona o outou, ma lenei foi tupulaga; ioe, ma e oo lava i le Tamā ua olioli, ma agelu paia uma foi, ona o outou ma lenei tupulaga, ona ua leai so latou ua se.

verses.en: Behold, I would that ye should understand; for I mean them who are now alive of this generation; and none of them are lost; and in them I have fulness of joy.
verses.sm: Faauta, ou te manao ia outou malamalama; aua e faatatau la’u tala ia te i latou o loo ola nei o le tupulaga lenei; ma ua leai so latou ua se; ma o i latou ia ua ou maua ai le atoatoa o le olioli.

verses.en: But behold, it sorroweth me because of the fourth generation from this generation, for they are led away captive by him even as was the son of perdition; for they will sell me for silver and for gold, and for that which moth doth corrupt and which thieves can break through and steal. And in that day will I visit them, even in turning their works upon their own heads.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, ua ou faanoanoa ona o le tupulaga lona fa mai le tupulaga lenei, ona e ta’ita’i ese faatagataotauaina i latou e ia e pei lava o le atalii o le malaia; ona o le a latou faatau atu a’u mo ario ma auro, ma mo mea na e faaleaga e mogamoga ma mea e mafai e tagata gaoi ona osofaia ma gaoi ai. Ma i lena aso o le a ou asiasi atu ai ia te i latou, e oo i le liliuina o a latou galuega i luga o o latou lava ulu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when Jesus had ended these sayings he said unto his disciples: Enter ye in at the strait gate; for strait is the gate, and narrow is the way that leads to life, and few there be that find it; but wide is the gate, and broad the way which leads to death, and many there be that travel therein, until the night cometh, wherein no man can work.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona faaiuina e Iesu o ia fetalaiga sa ia fetalai atu ai i ona soo: Ia outou ulufale atu i le faitotoa vaapiapi; aua e vaapiapi le faitotoa, ma lauitiiti le ala e tau atu i le ola, ma e toaitiiti i latou o e latou te mauaina; ae ua vatele le faitotoa, ma lautele le ala e tau atu i le oti, ma e toatele i latou o ē e ui atu ai, seia oo mai le po, e le mafai e se tagata ona galue ai.
